modules.title: 订单模块怎样在真实支付服务与可控替身间切换
替身让什么变得可测试

items.title: 把难以安排的结果变成稳定输入
items.text: 真实支付服务未必能随时制造“被拒绝”或“超时”。测试替身可按用例返回指定结果，让失败提示、重试或记录逻辑得到可重复检查。

items.title: 替身要对应要验证的边界
items.text: 若目标是订单模块面对拒绝时的行为，替身很合适；若目标是确认与真实支付商的协议和认证仍可用，就必须在受控环境做真实连接验证。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 测试替身不是生产环境里的模拟服务，也不等于所有 Mock。它只在测试中替代某个依赖；它能证明被测模块如何应对预设结果，不能证明真实依赖当前一定正常。

lessonPractice.title: 你要验证“支付被拒绝时页面显示重试入口”，真实支付沙箱偶尔不可用。最合适的是？

options.label: 让支付测试替身稳定返回拒绝，再断言页面显示重试入口
options.feedback: 对。测试重点是页面如何处理拒绝，替身让这个前提可重复。

options.label: 一直等真实支付服务恰好返回拒绝
options.feedback: 前提不可控，测试会慢且不稳定，难以重复。

options.label: 只用替身通过，就宣布真实支付集成已验证
options.feedback: 替身不证明真实服务连接、认证或协议没有问题。

en.title: You need to verify that a rejected payment shows a retry entry, but the real payment sandbox is sometimes unavailable. What is best?

options.label: Have a payment test double consistently return rejection, then assert the page shows retry
options.feedback: Correct. The test asks how the page handles rejection, and the double makes that prerequisite repeatable.

options.label: Wait until the real payment service happens to reject
options.feedback: The prerequisite is uncontrolled, slow, unstable, and hard to repeat.

options.label: If the double passes, declare real payment integration verified
options.feedback: A double does not prove real service connection, authentication, or protocol works.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为支付被拒绝补一个测试替身，让它稳定返回拒绝；验证页面会显示可点击的重试入口。另保留一条受控环境的真实支付连接检查，不要用替身结果代替它。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a test double that consistently returns payment rejection and verify the page shows a clickable retry entry. Keep one controlled-environment real payment connection check as well; do not substitute the double result for it.

learning.assumes: You know a page or module may depend on payment, email, or a third-party API.
learning.outcome: You can tell when to isolate an uncontrolled dependency and when a real-service connection still needs verification.

modules.title: How an order module switches between real payment and a controllable double

items.title: Turn hard-to-arrange outcomes into stable input
items.text: A real payment service may not reliably produce rejection or timeout on demand. A double returns a specified result for a case, making error display, retry, and logging repeatable.

items.title: Match the double to the boundary under test
items.text: A double suits testing an order module’s response to rejection; verifying protocol and authentication with the real provider still needs a controlled real connection.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A test double is not a simulated production service and not another word for every Mock. It replaces one dependency only during tests; it proves how the unit handles preset outcomes, not that the real dependency is currently healthy.

distinctions.label: Test data and Fixture
distinctions.text: A {c:test-double} replaces the behavior of a real dependency with something controllable. A {c:test-fixture} prepares and cleans up the data and environment a test needs.
